prompt: Create a NEW game sprite atlas matching the miniature full-body action-sprite style of the reference image, not portrait cards and not separate puppet body parts. EXACTLY 4 equal columns by 5 equal rows, 20 separate full-body sprites, all facing RIGHT, consistent size and foot baseline, pure transparent alpha between and behind every figure, no scenery, no floor, no rectangle backgrounds, no text or grid lines. Canvas portrait 4:5. Every figure and weapon must stay entirely inside its own cell with transparent padding. Column sequence for every row: 1 idle ready stance, 2 strong raised-weapon anticipation, 3 extended forward attack with changed arms/body/legs, 4 recoil/recovery pose. Bold compact miniature proportions, readable 2D painted dark fantasy game sprites, slightly stylized action-figure silhouettes, high-quality detailed armor, grounded feet. ROW 1 WARDEN: black hood with COMPLETELY featureless black void face, worn bronze-and-iron armor, charcoal cloak, sword and small shield. ROW 2 RANGER: featureless opaque dark hood and full face wrap, moss-green cloak and leather armor, short sword, light agile crouched attack. ROW 3 ARCANIST: deep burgundy hood and robe, face entirely opaque shadow without ANY features, metal bracers, slender glowing ember sword, spellblade thrust. ROW 4 REAVER: fully closed plain dark helmet, no eye slits or facial features, heavy black armor and tattered red cloth, broad heavy sword, powerful overhead swing. ROW 5 APOTHECARY: teal hood, opaque full cloth face covering, leather apron, vial belt, short blade, nimble forward strike. ALL hands covered with gauntlets/gloves; NO visible faces, eyes, nose, mouth, or skin anywhere. Same hero design preserved perfectly across each row's four poses. Weapon movement must be obvious from pose to pose; no giant VFX (added in engine). Clean actual RGBA transparent output. Reference is style and pose cadence only; do not copy its enemies or row count.
packing_edit: Fix only the sprite-sheet packing of this image. Preserve these exact five hero designs, four poses each, and transparent background. Arrange in a mathematically EVEN 4-column x 5-row grid (20 cells), with EACH sprite including its entire sword/hand/cloak fitting inside its own cell. Scale sprites down uniformly so the longest attacking sword fits with at least 10% transparent padding on the left and right of EACH cell, and 8% padding top and bottom. All four poses in a row must use the SAME body scale and foot baseline. No sprite pixels may cross a cell boundary. In particular shorten the visual reach by scaling down, not cutting off blades. Do not crop any sword or hood. Keep real alpha 0 between sprites. No text, frames, grid lines or scenery. Keep all hood interiors featureless opaque black. Keep Reaver helmet entirely closed WITHOUT eye holes or slits. Final output aspect 4:5.
